name: Wilhelt, the Rotcleaver
oracle_text:
Whenever another Zombie you control dies, if it didn't have decayed, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed. (It can't block. When it attacks, sacrifice it at end of combat.)
At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice a Zombie. If you do, draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever another Zombie you control dies, if it didn't have decayed, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed

needs.what: `not_keywords` in a trigger filter (TRIGGER_FILTER_KEYS / triggers.matches_card_filter), answered from the dying creature's last-known keywords, so a `creature_dies` trigger can say "another Zombie you control dies, if it didn't have decayed" -- filter {controller: you, subtypes: [Zombie], exclude_self: true, not_keywords: [decayed]}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys carries `keywords` but not its negation `not_keywords` (validate_trigger_filter refuses it), and matches_card_filter reads the printed card face only, so a creature that was granted decayed would not be seen either. A trigger `condition` has no last-known-keywords value (value_keys has counters_had, power_had, toughness_had but no keywords_had), and an `exists` over the subject reads a creature that has already left the battlefield. Dropping the clause would make every decayed token that dies replace itself forever.
